title: Dastak Protocol
description: A data-only protocol definition for the Dastak multi-protocol engine. The engine interprets this schema; it never contains clinical logic.

id.description: Unique protocol identifier. Lowercase, underscores only.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the launcher and context band.

start.description: ID of the first step to render.

status.description: 'demo-ready' requires every step to have a non-UNSOURCED content_source.

version.description: Semantic version for this protocol file.

steps.description: Ordered array of step definitions. The engine builds a step map from this array.

id.description: Unique step ID within this protocol.

prompt.description: The question or instruction shown to the worker. Must be worker-facing, about the beneficiary.

type.description: Step type. The engine renders exactly one frame per step.

content_source.description: 'UNSOURCED' or a citation string. Build fails if demo-ready protocol has UNSOURCED steps.

next.description: ID of the next step. null means end of protocol. For yesno, use onYes/onNo instead.

danger.description: If true, this is a danger/referral frame. Rendered with red accent.

referral.description: Referral text shown on danger frames.

rule.description: Escalation rule: if the condition is met, jump to target step instead of next.

options.description: For choice/range types: the options the worker selects from.

onYes.description: Step ID to go to on Yes (yesno type only).

onNo.description: Step ID to go to on No (yesno type only).

skippable.description: For group type: whether the group can be skipped. Default true.

repeat.description: For group type: repeat configuration bound to an earlier answer.

option.description: An option within a choice or range step.

value.description: The value recorded when this option is selected.

next.description: Optional per-option next step ID for branching. Falls through to step.next if absent.

rule.description: Escalation rule evaluated after the worker selects an answer.

op.description: Comparison operator. 'in' checks if value is in an array.

value.description: Value to compare against. For 'in', an array of values.

target.description: Step ID to jump to if the condition is met.

bind.description: Step ID whose answer determines the repeat count.
